mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AGENT_TASK ( TASK_ID, AGENT_ID, TASK_TYPE, TASK_AREA, TASK_TITLE, TASK_CONTENT, ACTION_STATUS, START_TIME, END_TIME, TASK_NOTE, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_AGENT_TASK.NEXTVAL, NVL(#{agentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'AGENT01'), #{taskType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskArea, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{taskTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '제목 없음'), NVL(#{taskContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '내용 없음'), NVL(#{actionStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING'), #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskNote, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE AGENT_TASK SET TASK_TYPE = #{taskType}, TASK_AREA = #{taskArea}, TASK_TITLE = #{taskTitle}, TASK_CONTENT = #{taskContent}, ACTION_STATUS = #{actionStatus}, START_TIME = #{startTime}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, TASK_NOTE = #{taskNote} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT TASK_ID AS taskId, AGENT_ID AS agentId, TASK_TYPE AS taskType, TASK_AREA AS taskArea, TASK_TITLE AS taskTitle, TASK_CONTENT AS taskContent, ACTION_STATUS AS actionStatus, START_TIME AS startTime, END_TIME AS endTime, TASK_NOTE AS taskNote, REG_DATE AS regDate FROM AGENT_TASK ORDER BY TASK_ID DESC
